sources.title: JustANormalTinkerer/hayai-ocr-v2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Hayai OCR v2 Hayai is a compact vision-to-text OCR model. It pairs a SigLIP2 vision encoder with a causal transformer decoder to read text directly out of images, without a separate detection stage.

sources.title: Hayai OCR v2 - a Hugging Face Space by JustANormalTinkerer
sources.snippet: Hayai OCR v2 A compact 155M-parameter OCR model that maps images directly to transcribed text. Supports Japanese, Chinese, and English text recognition. Upload an image and get the text!

sources.title: hayai-ocr · PyPI
sources.snippet: Project description Hayai OCR (速いOCR) Fast optical character recognition for Japanese text, with the main focus being Japanese manga. A fork of manga-ocr by kha-white, rebuilt with a SigLIP2 + BERT encoder-decoder architecture for improved accuracy and speed.
